reviews.reason: Verified NVIDIA board announcement (2026-11-12) confirms Jensen Huang resigned as President/CEO, supporting the factual basis. The −1 scoring for losing the living founder-protagonist is a judgment call grounded in the verified event; founding history itself unchanged, so mild deduction is consistent.

Same verified board announcement supports the factual claim that the founder-CEO exited and CFO Colette Kress was named interim CEO. The stronger 9→7 deduction reflects the judge's own founder-CEO thesis applied to a verified fact; no unsupported causal or outcome claims asserted as source-proven.

The NVIDIA board press release (2026-11-12) explicitly confirms Jensen Huang resigned as President and CEO with CFO Colette Kress as interim CEO. The factual assertions — resignation, interim CFO, end of the 30-year living founder narrative — are directly supported. The modest 9→8 adjustment correctly avoids claiming any post-event outcome; it only reclassifies the origin story from current to historical, which the source supports.

The prediction of 'manager-mode drift' is the judge's own opinion, but it is framed as an expectation rather than a source-proven effect, and no post-event outcome is asserted as fact. The evidentiary basis for the 8→6 change holds.

Verified NVIDIA announcement confirms founder-CEO Jensen Huang resigned with CFO Kress as interim CEO, supporting the claim that the founder-centered origin narrative loses its protagonist; the interpretive scoring judgment is consistent with the verified facts.
